name: Brute Force

features.name: xNudge Wilds
features.description: Three types of stacked wilds with random multipliers.

features.name: xNudge Meter
features.description: Adds up all the multipliers on winning symbols.

review:
A 5x5 action game with three types of stacked xNudge wilds, each nudging into view and showing a random multiplier. The xNudge Meter adds up every multiplier on winning symbols, so you can watch what a spin is worth as it builds.

Three scatters give ten Brute Spins; four give ten Super Brute Spins, where nudge wilds can stick. Paid boosters make sure one or two xNudge wilds land every spin. Insane volatility, 40,000x max.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
